matched_pairs.gold_statement: Set trust_env to False to make HTTPX ignore environment variables
matched_pairs.live_statement: To make HTTPX ignore environment variables, set trust_env to False.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: Response history lists followed redirect responses in order
matched_pairs.live_statement: The history property of the response contains a list of any redirect responses that were followed, in the order in which they were made.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: WSGITransport uses remote_addr to set the request client address
matched_pairs.live_statement: The WSGI transport option that sets the request client address is remote_addr.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: The scripts/test command runs the HTTPX test suite
matched_pairs.live_statement: The project script that runs the HTTPX test suite is scripts/test.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX does not follow redirects by default
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX does not follow redirects by default.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: Use an http URL scheme for the proxy instead of https
matched_pairs.live_statement: The proxy handshake timeout on HTTPS requests is resolved by changing the scheme of the HTTPS proxy to http:// instead of https://.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: The zstandard optional dependency enables zstd response decoding
matched_pairs.live_statement: The optional dependency zstandard enables decoding for zstd compressed responses.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX default timeout for network inactivity is five seconds
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX's default timeout for network inactivity is five seconds.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX stream iteration normalises all line endings to \n
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX will use universal line endings, normalising all cases to \n.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX supports asyncio and trio as async environments
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX supports either asyncio or trio as an async environment.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: An AsyncClient can be closed explicitly with await client.aclose()
matched_pairs.live_statement: An AsyncClient can be closed explicitly using the await client.aclose() method.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX does not follow redirects by default, unlike requests
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX does not follow redirects by default, unlike requests.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX encodes str request bodies as utf-8, not latin1 like Requests
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX uses utf-8 for encoding str request bodies, not latin1.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: Environment variables are ignored when trust_env is set to False
matched_pairs.live_statement: To make HTTPX ignore environment variables, set trust_env to False.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX does not properly support HTTPS proxies at this time
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX does not properly support HTTPS proxies at this time.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPS proxy handshake timeouts are fixed by changing the proxy scheme from https:// to http://
matched_pairs.live_statement: The proxy handshake timeout on HTTPS requests is resolved by changing the scheme of the HTTPS proxy to http:// instead of https://.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: HTTPX currently has two event hooks: request and response
matched_pairs.live_statement: HTTPX supports two event hooks: 'request' and 'response'.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: A custom CA bundle is passed via the verify parameter
matched_pairs.live_statement: A custom CA bundle can be supplied for SSL verification using the verify parameter with a path to the certificate file.

matched_pairs.gold_statement: Response.elapsed measures the time between sending the request and closing the response
matched_pairs.live_statement: The Response.elapsed property measures the amount of time elapsed between sending the request and calling close() on the corresponding response received for that request.
